_comment: Per-sport site identity — single source of truth for org/website JSON-LD AND page chrome (header brand/nav, <title> suffix, og/canonical base, default theme). A competition resolves its site via its top-level `sport` field (config/competitions.json). This repo is basketball-only; the engine's soccer fallback stays dormant (no soccer comps/articles exist). `base` has no trailing slash (code appends it). ga_id is added after Charlie creates the GA4 property (empty = engine falls back to the soccer GA id, so DO add it before deploy or strip the snippet).
